_comment: Records a source lists as groups that are not languoids: catalog groupings by modality or status, not families with a common ancestor (the owner's decision, 2026-11-08). The build leaves them out of the tree: their members move up to the nearest real ancestor, or become top-level languoids. Each member keeps the grouping it was listed under as that source's claim (classification.<source>.grouping in languoid.json). Keys: the record's id in that source; values: its name, for reading only.
